versionRule: The subtype name carries the major: v2 when a declared field changes meaning, is removed, or a v1 reader statement would be false of the record. This file's SHA-256 carries the revisions: an added entry with an absence rule, a new reader sentence or a corrected citation stays v1 and moves the digest and the verifier table row's pin (ADR-0038 section 2).
producer: The reference host of this project, civicaitools.org, through the composed harness (ADR-0033, ADR-0037). Every new record of this producer, full-text or hash-only, declares this subtype.

contentProfiles.rule: When both fields are present, metadata.contentProfile is one of the values this row admits. datHere is the A-G envelope (spec section 8.7, its requirements binding on such a record); default is the plain shape, which a hash-only record of this producer carries. The values and their meaning do not change here.
contentProfiles.readers: Spec section 8.1.1 and section 6.2 state the invariant; section 9.2 check #16 reads it.

captureMethods.note: The capture vocabulary is the profile type's (ADR-0011, the G4 decision; spec section 8.6): chat-flow-stream, claude-code-jsonl-readback, claude-code-self-report. This subtype constrains and extends nothing.

classes.shows: A host that shows the sources a run reached derives and shows this statement (SHOULD).
classes.may-show: A host MAY derive and show this statement; its absence from a page says nothing about the record.
classes.never-invents: No host states this from a record of this subtype, because the record does not hold it; its absence renders as not recorded, never as a default.

absenceRule: Every entry below is emitted only when the producer knows its value (ADR-0024; ADR-0033 section C). An absent key states nothing: a host renders it as not recorded, and never as a default, a zero or an empty list (ADR-0033's honest-absence rule).

fields.values: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD: the 'today' the composed prompt stated to the model.
fields.absent: Key omitted when the run's root span carried no analysis.asserted_date.
fields.carriedBy: packages/civic-typed-harness/src/__fixtures__/in-loop-golden.json (2026-10-19); the published records of this producer since harness 0.7.0.
fields.sentence: The model was told the date was {assertedDate}.

fields.values: One entry per manifest source in manifest order: { sourceId, alias, reason }, reason one of configured, not-configured, selected, not-selected, reader-off, not-consented (ADR-0033 section E and its 2026-10-18 amendment). A source was offered exactly when its reason is configured or selected.
fields.absent: Key omitted when the run's root span carried no analysis.sources_offered.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (three entries); the three fixture records of the reference host's flows tests (record-2f32d9, record-397939, record-d887c1 at website 567a7c2).
fields.sentence: Supplies the never-asked group of the chooser sentence (see composition.routing) and, per source, why it was not reached: {alias}: {reason as the host's sentence for it}. The host names the source from its own manifest by sourceId; the record never spells the reader-facing name.

fields.values: One entry per offered source in manifest order, then one for the composing package: { id, version?, guidanceHash?, guidanceOrigin? }; guidanceHash is lowercase hex SHA-256 of the guidance text as composed; guidanceOrigin is present exactly when guidanceHash is, one of endpoint, inline, fallback.
fields.absent: Key omitted when the root span carried no analysis.components. A missing version or guidanceHash is unknown or no guidance, respectively; neither is stated as a placeholder.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (socrata 0.9.2 with endpoint guidance; the router 0.5.0); the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: Composed from: {id} {version} (guidance {guidanceOrigin}, hash {guidanceHash short}); ... . Until a record carries skillMetadata.skillText (website #694), these entries are the record's only statement of the prompt's pieces, by hash and origin, not by text.

fields.values: { url, hash, date }, keys in that order: the address the instance serves its flows statement at (absolute http: or https:, no credentials), the statement's version as lowercase hex SHA-256, and its YYYY-MM-DD date. By reference only; never the statement's content (ADR-0033 amendment of 2026-10-18; ADR-0036 section D).
fields.absent: Key omitted when the root span carried no analysis.flows_statement (every record before harness 0.9.0).
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-d887c1 (website 567a7c2).
fields.sentence: Where this question's data went is described by the flows statement of {date} at {url} (version {hash short}).

fields.values: { method, version }, keys in that order. method one of all-sources, picker, in-loop (ADR-0033 amendment 2); version is the router's version. This producer writes the key on an in-loop run only, with method in-loop; an all-sources run writes no routing key (website src/lib/evidence/trace.ts, IN_LOOP_RUN_RECORD_ATTRIBUTE, and src/lib/mcp/routing-mode.ts at 567a7c2), and nothing emits picker.
fields.absent: Key omitted when the root span carried no analysis.routing: every all-sources run of this producer, and every record published before in-loop routing reached production (2026-10-27). Absent reads as not recorded, never as all-sources.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (in-loop, router 0.5.0). No public record of the reference host carried it at 2026-10-30 12:35Z (R10-WEB's census: 61 public records, 13 with the composition block, 0 with routing).
fields.sentence: Shown wherever reached sources are shown, read from routing.method, the load spans and sourcesOffered. in-loop: 'The model chose which sources to use: it loaded {loaded}; it asked about {asked, each with the reader's answer}; it did not ask for {never asked}.' Beside it the host MAY say 'through the civic router {version}'. absent: 'How the sources were chosen: not recorded.' all-sources, only if a record of this producer ever states that method: 'Every configured source was offered from the first request.'

fields.values: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the run's harness definition { domain, sources, components, chosenBy } in the router's canonical JSON (ADR-0037 section E). The harness states the value as the router computed it and computes nothing.
fields.absent: Key omitted when the root span carried no analysis.definition_hash: every all-sources run, and every record before harness 0.10.0.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json. No public record of the reference host carried it at 2026-10-30 12:35Z (the census above).
fields.sentence: May be shown as small print beside the chooser sentence: 'harness definition {definitionHash}'. The definition's contents are never stated from the record: the hash resolves to nothing until the definition is a node type (ADR-0037 section E), so a host states the hash and no more.

fields.values: The tools array as offered to the model, in offered order, verbatim (the router's output: load_source and each loaded source's tools), or a BlobRef when large (spec section 8.7.1 requirement 3; ADR-0033 section C).
fields.absent: Key omitted when the producer does not know the tools the run offered. Records published before harness 0.7.0 carry the placeholder [] and are not re-labelled.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: Tools offered to the model: {count}, named {names}.

fields.values: { executedAt, environment: { python, libraries }, executionDuration_ms, comparisonCellPresent?, sandboxId? }, the shape spec section 8.7.4 gives the execution extension. Measured at website 567a7c2 (src/lib/notebook-author/phase-d.ts), the reference host writes the block inside the notebook's own metadata at this path, not at the top-level extensions["org.civicaitools.execution"] section 8.7.4 names; a host reads it where the record carries it. The divergence is recorded in ADR-0038 and not resolved by this bundle.
fields.absent: Absent when the notebook was not executed by the publisher's pipeline (a skeleton notebook, provenance absent or skeleton); then the record states nothing about an execution.
fields.carriedBy: The three website fixture records (executed 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-20). Not carried by in-loop-golden.json, whose notebook is a skeleton.
fields.sentence: Executed at {executedAt} on Python {python} with {libraries}, in {executionDuration_ms} ms.

fields.values: The structured two-clause summary the notebook author produced, stamped in the notebook's root metadata when the author step supplied one (website src/lib/notebook-author/synthesize.ts at 567a7c2). The record's top-level summary (spec section 8.1.1, section G) is a separate field and the one a datHere record requires.
fields.absent: Absent when the author step supplied no structured summary; none of the three measured fixture records carries it, and in-loop-golden.json does not. A host reads section G from the top-level summary and states nothing from this block when it is absent.
fields.carriedBy: No measured fixture record carries it. The reference host's answer view reads it when present (src/components/answer-view/buildChatEvidenceView.ts at 567a7c2).
fields.sentence: The structured summary's clauses, as the host's section G rendering, only when present.

fields.values: skeleton or executed (spec section 8.7.4; ADR-0005). Measured at website 567a7c2 (src/lib/notebook-author/synthesize.ts and phase-d.ts), the reference host writes the discriminator inside the notebook's own metadata at this path, not at extensions["org.civicaitools.notebook"].provenance as section 8.7.4 names it; a host reads it where the record carries it. The divergence is recorded in ADR-0038 and not resolved by this bundle.
fields.absent: Absent on a skeleton notebook written by the chat-flow path; section 8.7.4 has a verifier read absence as skeleton, and a host labels the notebook as a skeleton, never as executed.
fields.carriedBy: The three website fixture records (executed). Not carried by in-loop-golden.json (a skeleton).
fields.sentence: executed: 'Executed notebook: the answer was derived from computed data; re-execution is reproducible against the documented runtime and the upstream data as of publish time.' skeleton or absent: 'Skeleton notebook: the answer was authored in chat; the data fetch is reproducible, the answer synthesis is not.' (spec section 8.7.3 item 4 and section 8.7.4's labelling convention, a SHOULD).

fields.values: load_source on a load span: a call the instance's own loop handled through the router's directory, which no source answered (ADR-0033 amendment 2; ADR-0037 section C). Other spans carry the producer's other operation types (query, search, metadata, ...).
fields.absent: No load span is present on an all-sources run, where the model is offered no load_source tool, and on every record before in-loop routing. Then the record states that no source was loaded during the run, not that none was reached.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (one load span, loaded).
fields.sentence: Identifies the load spans from which the chooser sentence's loaded and asked groups are read (see composition.routing): 'the model asked for {alias}'.

fields.values: One of loaded, declined, no-answer, unavailable, not-offered (LOAD_OUTCOMES, format/vocabulary.ts): the source's guidance and tools were added; the reader did not allow the source for this run; no decision arrived in time; the instance could not offer the source for a reason known without contacting it; the alias named no source of the directory set.
fields.absent: Present on every load span: the harness refuses a load span with no outcome or another value when it builds the graph (LoadSpanError), so a record never states a load without saying how it ended.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (loaded).
fields.sentence: Per load, the chooser sentence's verb: loaded 'it loaded {alias}'; declined 'it asked about {alias}, and you said no'; no-answer 'it asked about {alias}, and no answer arrived in time'; unavailable 'it asked for {alias}, which could not be offered'; not-offered 'it asked for {alias}, which this site does not offer'. The outcome tells 'the model wanted this source and did not get it' from 'the model never asked'.

fields.values: true, only when the producer stated that the source refused the call; never false.
fields.absent: Absent when nothing was recorded about how the call ended: the record states nothing, and a reader never reads the absence as success (spec section 8.1.8).
fields.carriedBy: No measured fixture record carries it (no fixture call was refused); emitted by the harness since produce-core 0.4.0 whenever a queries[] entry carries failed: true.
fields.sentence: '{source} refused this call.' Nothing when absent.

fields.values: An open producer label beside civic:failed, stated verbatim; the reference producer's four values are timeout, unavailable, not_configured, unknown. No normative vocabulary.
fields.absent: Absent unless civic:failed is present; a kind without a failure is not a rejection.
fields.carriedBy: No measured fixture record carries it.
fields.sentence: '{source} refused this call ({failureKind}).' A host never switches on the value exhaustively or treats an unknown one as invalid.

fields.path: provenance["@graph"][] (prov:Entity: prompt, skill, output, tool-argument, data-response)["civic:contentHash"]
fields.values: sha256:<hex>, the SHA-256 of the bytes the entity stands for.
fields.absent: Present on every entity the graph mints for content the producer held; absent on an entity whose bytes the producer did not hold.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'Content hash {hex short}'; a reader hashes the content it holds and compares.

fields.values: The MCP server URL the source agent answered from, as the deployment's source registry states it (or, for the skill source, as the skill-fetch span carried it).
fields.absent: Absent on an agent whose address the producer did not state.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'Answered by {source} at {serverUrl host}.'

fields.values: The stable registry id of the source that answered a call, on the source agent, the tool-call activity and the data-response entity. A load span's activity states none: no source answered it.
fields.absent: Absent on a call no source answered (a load) and on a call whose source the span did not name; the graph never defaults a source id (ADR-0024).
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: '{the host's name for sourceId} answered this call.' The host resolves the id against its own manifest; the record never spells the reader-facing name.

fields.values: The public URL of the platform agent that published the record, a typed config input of the deployment.
fields.absent: Present whenever the platform agent is minted; absent only when the deployment states no address.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'Published by {url host}.'

fields.values: The prompt tokens the inference span reported, an integer.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no count; never zero-filled.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: '{n} prompt tokens' for the inference. Nothing when absent.

fields.values: The completion tokens the inference span reported, an integer.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no count; never zero-filled.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: '{n} completion tokens' for the inference. Nothing when absent.

fields.values: The tool the call invoked, verbatim from the span: the name the model called, which under ADR-0032 is <alias>__<upstream name>.
fields.absent: Absent when the span named no tool; never a placeholder.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'Called {toolName}.'

fields.values: The producer's classification of what the call did (query, search, metadata, load_source, unknown, ...), an open string stated verbatim.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no tool.operation_type.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'A {operationType} call.'

fields.values: The dataset a data response came from, when the span carried one and the source is dataset-keyed.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no dataset id (a search, a metadata call, a non-dataset source).
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-2f32d9 and record-d887c1.
fields.sentence: 'Data from dataset {datasetId}.'

fields.values: The portal host the tool span carried. Never the run's selected portal: a call that addressed no portal yields a response attributed to none.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no portal host.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-2f32d9 and record-d887c1.
fields.sentence: 'From the portal {portalDomain}.'

fields.values: The canonical dataset URL, minted only when the span carried both the portal host and the dataset id.
fields.absent: Absent when either part is absent; a URL is never minted from a host the span did not state.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-2f32d9 and record-d887c1.
fields.sentence: A link to the dataset at {datasetUrl}.

fields.values: null: an explicit placeholder for a Croissant 1.1 metadata URL, named here because the key is inside signed bytes. No record of this producer carries a non-null value.
fields.absent: Absent on a response that is not dataset-keyed.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-2f32d9 and record-d887c1 (each null).
fields.sentence: Nothing: a null states no URL, and a host shows no Croissant link from a record of this subtype.

fields.values: The row count the tool response carried, an integer.
fields.absent: Absent when the span reported no row count.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; record-2f32d9 and record-d887c1.
fields.sentence: '{n} rows returned.'

fields.values: The elapsed milliseconds the producer measured for one tool call, on a call that answered and on one the source refused alike.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no duration.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.

fields.values: The server's own tool name, the name the call was sent under on the wire, when the name the model called is an aliased one (ADR-0033 section B; ADR-0032).
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no tool.upstream_name (a call to an unaliased tool).
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: 'Sent to the server as {upstreamToolName}.'

fields.values: The operator-facing alias of the source that answered the call, the prefix of an aliased tool name.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no mcp.alias.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json; the three website fixture records.
fields.sentence: The alias by which the chooser sentence names a source: 'it loaded {alias}'.

fields.values: The identity of the server that answered: the router manifest entry's id, which composition.components[].id also carries, so a call joins to its component.
fields.absent: Absent when the span carried no mcp.server.id.
fields.carriedBy: The three website fixture records. Not carried by in-loop-golden.json.
fields.sentence: 'Answered by {serverId}', joined to the component of the same id for its version and guidance hash.

fields.path: provenance["@graph"][] (prov:Activity, the tool call of a load span, associated with the platform agent)["civic:loadOutcome"]
fields.values: One of loaded, declined, no-answer, unavailable, not-offered, verbatim from the span's tool.load_outcome; the activity's last key, on no other node (ADR-0033 amendment 2).
fields.absent: Absent on every activity that is not a load; a graph never states a load without it.
fields.carriedBy: in-loop-golden.json (loaded).
fields.sentence: The graph's statement of trace.loadSpan.loadOutcome; a host reading the graph rather than the trace derives the same per-load verb from it.

fields.values: The composed system prompt the model ran under, inline or as a BlobRef when large (spec section 8.1.1; section 8.7.1 requirement 2 requires it non-empty on a datHere record).
fields.absent: Not carried by this producer's records so far: every published record of the reference host carries skillMetadata as {} (website #694, measured 2026-10-30 against two public records and the code at 567a7c2: the packager reads a skill_fetch span the composed-harness flow never writes, and the dialog sends no override). The record's composition names the prompt's pieces by guidanceHash and guidanceOrigin (composition.components). A record that carries the text meets requirement 2; one that does not is reported by spec section 9.2 check #17 as attention, never as a failure.
fields.carriedBy: No published record of this producer and no fixture of this producer at 2026-10-30. The harness fixture legacy-blobref-trace-skill-override (reference-golden.json) carries a BlobRef skillText from an override and is not a record of this host.
fields.sentence: Text present: section B renders the text (or the BlobRef's resolved text). Hash only (systemPromptHash present, skillText absent): 'The prompt's text was not carried; its hash is {systemPromptHash short}', with the composition's components listed by id, version and guidance hash. Neither: 'The prompt's text was not carried', with the same component list. A host never shows a prompt it reconstructs from the components as if the record carried it.

fields.values: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the composed system prompt as a whole (ADR-0033 section E: components[].guidanceHash is each piece's; this is the whole's). The trace of every measured record carries gen_ai.system_prompt_hash on an llm_inference span; the executed_notebook span's analysis.prompt_hash is the notebook author's prompt, a different hash in every measured record.
fields.absent: Not carried by this producer's records so far (website #694): skillMetadata is {} on every published record, while the trace's llm_inference span carries gen_ai.system_prompt_hash. A host MAY show the trace's hash as the trace's, never as skillMetadata's.
fields.carriedBy: No published record of this producer at 2026-10-30 (the hash is in each record's trace only: record-2f32d9, record-397939, record-d887c1 at website 567a7c2).
fields.sentence: Present: 'System prompt hash {systemPromptHash short}' in the Model + environment card. Absent: nothing, or 'not recorded' where the card has a row for it.

neverCarried.fact: Who consented to a source (the reader's identity).
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record of this subtype and no host states it from one. The consent itself is kept in the app's own store (the MCP-sources design, sections 1.6 and 4.4; ADR-0036). A record states only that a load was asked for and how it ended.

neverCarried.fact: When consent was given or withdrawn.
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record; no host states a consent time from one. The load span's own timing is the call's, not the consent's.

neverCarried.fact: The reader's account (the consent row's account column).
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record. A record's signer is the platform or the publisher, never the consenting reader.

neverCarried.fact: The reader's per-source consent states (On, Ask first, Off) as stored.
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record. sourcesOffered[].reason states the state's effect on the run (reader-off, not-consented), which is an outcome for one run and not the stored state; a host never reconstructs the consent panel from a record.

neverCarried.fact: The flows-version row of the consent store (which statement version the reader consented under).
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record. flowsStatement names the statement in force for the run by url, hash and date; it does not say the reader consented under it.

neverCarried.fact: The anonymous reader's session cookie or any session identifier.
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record; no host states one from a record.

neverCarried.fact: The flows statement's text (the recipients, what each receives, the postures their holders state).
neverCarried.rule: Never enters a record: the harness refuses a flowsStatement with any key beyond url, hash and date (format/dathere.ts). A host that shows the statement fetches it by url and checks the hash; it never presents the text as if the record carried it.
